newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, demand under market late.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, demand under market late.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed with the market beginning to firm into the close, traders said.
"It looked pretty precarious late in the day but there were bids for size (large volume buy orders) right under Wednesday's settlement levels," a trader said.
Traders said the market was hit early by profit taking but Dean Witter Reynolds was a scale-down buyer of March. ADM Investor Services also was a noted buyer.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 lots, above the 365 lots traded Wednesday.
Rice closed three cents per bushel higher to three lower, with January up three at $11.39.
